The Cylons, once humanity's servants, rebelled and evolved to resemble humans. After their attack leaves survivors, they adapt their strategy. Battlestar Galactica: The Plan follows two Cylon leaders determined to finish the job.

After forty years of uneasy peace, the Cylons launch a sudden attack on the Twelve Colonies, overwhelming defenses and wiping out major population centers in a devastating nuclear strike (Part 1 of 2).

After forty years of uneasy peace, the Cylons launch a sudden attack on the Twelve Colonies, overwhelming defenses and wiping out major population centers in a devastating nuclear strike (Part 2 of 2).
Laura and Adama face the possibility that one of their ships has been infiltrated by the enemy.
Boomer worries that she is responsible for a mysterious explosion that causes Galactica to lose more than half of its water.
Apollo is held hostage on a prisoner ship by a group of convicts led by a freedom fighter convicted of terrorism.
Starbuck is forced to admit her role in the death of Adama's son, Zak.
